summary.goal: Interface for answering agent questions that are blocking execution. Different from gates - these are runtime questions from agents.

acceptance_criteria.description: Queue showing pending questions from agents, sorted by priority_score
Question context: which agent, which task, blocking level
Pre-defined options or free-form text input for answers
Notification badge when new question arrives
Question type badges: BLOCKING (hard_block, red), PREFERENCE (soft_block, orange), FYI (fyi/preference, cyan)
Priority factors visible: steps_blocked, agents_waiting (= subscribers.length from backend)
Answer button sends response back to agent via POST /questions/:id/answer
Duplicate question detection: same-text questions merged with 'Asked by N agents'

observations: Questions come via request_human_input MCP tool
Priority scoring: blocking_level_value*100 + steps_blocked*10 + agents_waiting*15 + cascade_depth*5 - (can_use_default ? 30 : 0)
agents_waiting in UI = subscribers.length from Question entity in backend
Multiple agents may ask the same question - need duplicate handling
patterns: Triage panel pattern from design system
Question type badges from design system

duplicate_handling.display: Show as single card with 'Asked by N agents' subtitle
duplicate_handling.answer_behavior: Single answer applies to all duplicate questions via backend
duplicate_handling.api_note: Backend may expose grouped endpoint or client-side grouping needed
